headlines.title: Bill Ackman Explicitly Avoids Micron’s Volatile Cash Flows Focusing Here Instead
headlines.summary: Ackman passed on Micron's boom-and-bust memory cycle and bought a stock he calls predictable. But a spending surge is straining that promise, and the shares still lag the market. Can the cash flows he wants catch up?

headlines.title: AI Chips Update - Micron Highlights AI Leadership At Investor Events
headlines.summary: Micron Technology, Inc. has announced its participation in several upcoming investor events, including the TomorrowX Summit and the 30th Annual UBS Global Technology and AI Conference. These events emphasize Micron's role in the semiconductor memory and storage industry, particularly its contributions to AI and compute-intensive applications. The company's executives will be engaging in fireside chats, offering insights into Micron's technology leadership in the AI chip segment.

headlines.title: Micron Stock Is Rallying but the Memory Giant Needs Much More to Hit Former Heights
headlines.summary: Micron stock is up 16% in the past five trading sessions. Watch these factors for what happens next.

headlines.title: Micron Stock Has Moved 5% or More on a Third of Its Trading Days Since October. Here's How Much of It I'd Own.
headlines.summary: When a stock can lose around 30% of its value in five trading days, how big a stake is too big?

description: Micron Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of semiconductor memory and storage products in the United States, Taiwan, Mainland China, other Asia Pacific countries, Japan, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Cloud Memory Business Unit, Core Data Center Business Unit, Mobile and Client Business Unit, and Automotive and Embedded Business Unit segments. The company provides dynamic random access memory (DRAM) products, including High-Bandwidth Memory, doublie data rate, low-power DRAM, and graphics DRAM products; NAND products comprising solid state drives, managed NAND, and multi-chip packages; and NOR products. The company sells its products under the Micron brand name and private labels through its own direct sales force, sales or representative offices, as well as through distributors, retailers, and independent sales representatives. Micron Technology, Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Boise, Idaho.
